mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pk_daily_stats(user_id, stat_date, base_points_gained, streak_points_gained, net_points, wins, losses, draws, matches, highest_streak) VALUES(#{userId}, CURDATE(), #{basePoints}, #{streakPoints}, #{netPoints}, #{isWin}, #{isLoss}, #{isDraw}, 1, #{highestStreak}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE base_points_gained = base_points_gained + #{basePoints}, streak_points_gained = streak_points_gained + #{streakPoints}, net_points = net_points + #{netPoints}, wins = wins + (#{isWin} = true), losses = losses + (#{isLoss} = true), draws = draws + (#{isDraw} = true), matches = matches + 1, highest_streak = GREATEST(highest_streak, #{highestStreak})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pk_daily_stats WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND stat_date = CURDATE()
